parameters.normalization: Exact calculations use C_(N/2)=1; numerical physical C0 uses the stated common w_N

pair_source.interpretation: Both H^2 fields have only internal Gaussian pairings; their site overlaps retain charge-static covariance 4 lambda C^2. No Gaussian bridge does not imply no charge-static correlation for the whole-field oriented mark.

high_precision.numerical_scope: Two-precision full-binomial sums, no charge cutoff and no interval certificate. Finite errors are retained; the limit follows from the analytic uniform-integrability argument.

scope: Static charge background only, in beta=mu=0 normalized full-Fock trace; C_m uses the same w_N in every charge. G2 Gaussian-chaos zero is -D C_Q. This checks why two internal-only Gaussian fields can retain connected charge fluctuations. It does not construct the charged AA/AB/BA kernel or establish a general energy-plus-charge regression/pinching theorem.
